subject: App works locally, but fails on shinyapps.io without returning error

messages.author: fc7a5e926dfafa92
messages.subject: App works locally, but fails on shinyapps.io without returning error
parts:
Hi,

My app at arkaufman.shinyapps.io/textbias works perfectly when I run it on my local machine, and works perfectly on both a Linux VM anda EC2. However, when I deploy it to shinyapps.io, it deploys perfectly, but then crashes and greys out when accessed without returning an error. I don't know how to begin debugging this, and I'm worried that it is returning errors which it's not displaying. Any help is appreciated!

-Aaron

messages.subject: Re: App works locally, but fails on shinyapps.io without returning error

Can you run this in your R (RStudio) console:

shinyapps::showLogs()

This could be related to an issue that we are investigating. Your log results would help identifying the problem.

Thanks,
Fereshteh
